254: export async function action<T = Workspace>(
255:   a: Record<string, unknown>,
256: ): Promise<ActionDelivery<T>> {
257:   if (native) {
258:     const stamp = accessGate.stamp(typeof a.id === "string" ? a.id : undefined);
259:     const transition = [
260:       "lockNote",
261:       "unlockNote",
262:       "removeLock",
263:       "closeLocks",
264:       "deleteNote",
265:       "purgeNote",
266:       "deleteFolder",
267:     ].includes(String(a.type));
268:     return deliverAction<T>(
269:       stamp,
270:       a.type === "saveNote" ? "save" : transition ? "transition" : "read",
271:       () =>
272:         invoke<T>("workspace_action", {
273:           action: a,
274:           expected: accessGate.expected(
275:             a.type === "recoverConflictCopy" && typeof a.id === "string"
276:               ? a.id
277:               : undefined,
278:           ),
279:         }),
280:     );

184: export function projectFolders(
185:   workspace: Workspace,
186:   suspended: readonly string[] = [],
187:   sort: Settings["sort"] = "updated",
188: ): Map<string, FolderProjection> {
189:   const blocked = new Set([
190:     ...suspended,
191:     ...(workspace.access?.suspended || []),
192:   ]);
193:   const ordered = sortNotes(workspace.notes, sort);
194:   const facts = new Map(
195:     ordered.map((note) => [
196:       note.id,
197:       {
198:         eligible: note.deletedAt === null && !blocked.has(note.id),
199:         pinned: note.pinned,
200:         tags: note.locked ? null : documentTags(note.document),
201:       },
202:     ]),
203:   );
204:   const result = new Map<string, FolderProjection>();
205:   const add = (id: string, notes: readonly Note[], revision?: number) => {
206:     const ids = notes.map((n) => n.id);
207:     result.set(id, {
208:       ids,
209:       count: ids.length,
210:       firstId: ids[0] ?? null,
211:       ...(revision === undefined ? {} : { definitionRevision: revision }),
212:     });
213:   };
214:   add(
215:     "all",
216:     ordered.filter((n) => n.deletedAt === null),
217:   );
218:   for (const folder of workspace.folders)
219:     add(
220:       folder.id,
221:       ordered.filter((note) =>
222:         folder.kind === "smart"
223:           ? matchesSmart(folder.query, facts.get(note.id)!)
224:           : note.folderId === folder.id,
225:       ),
226:       folder.kind === "smart" ? folder.definitionRevision : undefined,
227:     );
